containerOverrides.name: migrate
command: import pg from 'pg'; import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { createPoolConfig } from './apps/server/dist/db/client.config.js'; const pool = new pg.Pool(createPoolConfig(process.env.DATABASE_URL, 'production', readFileSync(process.env.RDS_CA_BUNDLE, 'utf8'), 1)); try { const tables = await pool.query("select count(*)::int as n from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'public' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE'"); const migrations = await pool.query('select count(*)::int as n from drizzle.__drizzle_migrations'); const access = await pool.query("select has_table_privilege('tutorpair_pilot_app', 'public.users', 'SELECT') as can_read_users"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ publicTables: tables.rows[0].n, appliedMigrations: migrations.rows[0].n, appCanReadUsers: access.rows[0].can_read_users })); } finally { await pool.end(); }
